snippet.title: Curse of the Countess  | Cinematic Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Our first commercial release "Curse of the Countess" is launching in under 2 weeks! 
-
"Descend a gothic clocktower dreamscape to escape the curse of time. A short, atmospheric puzzle game that gently blends Sokoban mechanics, bullet-hell traversal, and dark mystery."
-
Wishlist on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5058090/Curse_of_the_Countess/
-
Join our Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/c/CepheidArts
Website: https://CepheidArts.com
-
